lines.text: I fell far below the ground
With no way out to be found
Lost somewhere before the dawn
A flickering ember caught my eye
And I felt it in my veins
Something calling out my name
Through the cracks I see the flame
I won't let it fade again
All these years you thought I was hiding
Beneath the ground
Now I'm breaking all the way
Through to the surface
Chasing echoes in the haze
Amid these storms I carried the weight
I found my way beyond the dawn
The flickering ember still remains
And I feel it burning in my veins
Something screaming out my name
Through the cracks it found a way
I'll never let it fade again
All these years you thought I was hiding
Beneath the ground
Now I'm breaking all the way
Through to the surface
You thought that this was over?
You thought I'd fade away?
Every voice that tried to break me
Only fed the flame inside me
Left in the dark, forgotten, thrown away
Yet somehow the seed kept finding its way
The roots ran deeper in the pouring rain
Drawing all my strength from the pressure and the pain
I pushed against the dirt that held me down
To reach above the dark that kept me bound
And all along, my hope refused to drown
'Cause the ember in my heart was still alive
Now I see it in the distance
Burning brighter than ever before
What was buried once
Won't stay there anymore
All these years you thought I was hiding
Beneath the ground
Now I'm breaking all the way
Through to the surface
All these years I've been fighting
Beneath the ground
Now I'm breaking all the way
Through to the surface
